assumptions: Two-state one-dimensional run-and-tumble process; positive bounded speeds, spatially varying reversal rates; v0>v1>0, gamma0>=gamma1>0, u>0, g=3u.
integrity: Exact algebraic derivative and root-count proof with a self-contained symbolic and numerical diagnostic checker; finite checks do not replace infinite-parameter proof; independent scientific validation not performed.
scientific_limitations: Complete critical-point classification only for g=3u; an exact three-peak witness persists under small full-parameter perturbations. The zero-current stationary density is from the cited prior work. No claim about stochastic relaxation, arbitrary gradient ratios, or experimental peak resolution.
title: Trimodal stationary states and the exact fold boundary for saturating run-and-tumble motion
